mechanism: Medroxyprogesterone may increase hydrocortisone metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing corticosteroid efficacy, while hydrocortisone may enhance medroxyprogesterone effects through altered hepatic metabolism and increased protein binding displacement.
action: Monitor for reduced corticosteroid efficacy and consider hydrocortisone dose adjustment if using medroxyprogesterone concurrently; assess clinical response to both medications regularly.
